title: Ameliorative effect of Alangium chinense (Lour.) Harms on rheumatoid arthritis by reducing autophagy with targeting regulate JAK3-STAT3 and COX-2 pathways.
authors: Xiao, Ting; Cheng, Xingyan; Zhi, Yuan; Tian, Fangfang; Wu, Ai; Huang, Feilong; Tao, Ling; Guo, Zhenghong; Shen, Xiangchun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药八角枫提取物对类风湿关节炎的改善作用及JAK3-STAT3和COX-2通路机制，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Alangium chinense has been used as traditional folk medicine for centuries to treat rheumatoid arthritis (RA) by Guizhou Miao nationality with remarkable clinical effect. But the mechanism of its anti-RA is not fully clarified. AIM OF THE STUDY: To explore the effect and underlying mechanism of A. chinense against RA. MATERIAL AND METHODS: RA rats were induced by CII/IFA, and oral administrated with or without ethyl acetate extracts of Alangium chinense (ACEE) and tripterygium glycosides (GTW). Then arthritis scores, inflammatory factors in serum and histological evaluation were evaluated to assess the degree of joints disease. Proteomics were conducted via LC-MS/MS to clarify the mechanism of ACEE preliminarily, and further examined by immunohistochemistry, immunofluorescence, western botting, and molecular docking. RESULTS: ACEE decreased joints swelling, cell abscission and necrosis of joint tissues arthropathy of RA rats, and attenuated expression of TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, IL-6, PGE2, TGF-beta. Meanwhile, differentially expressed proteins in the ACEE treated groups were observed, which were involved in RA, spliceosome, cell adhesion molecules, phagosome and lysosome signaling pathways. Moreover, ACEE significantly ameliorated arthropathy, suppressed JAK-STAT pathway (JAK3, p-JAK3, STAT3, iNOS, RANKL), COX-2 pathway (COX-2, TNF-alpha, IL-6I, L-1beta, 5-LOX), and autophagic signaling pathway (LC3-Ⅰ, LC3-Ⅱ, p62, mTOR). But it showed little effect on the expression of COX-1, JAK1, JAK2, TyK2. CONCLUSION: It is the first evidence that A. chinense significantly ameliorates RA, and the underlying immune mechanism involves reducing autophagy with targeting regulate JAK3-STAT3 and COX-2 pathways.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：八角枫（Alangium chinense）作为传统民间药物，已被贵州苗族用于治疗类风湿关节炎（RA）数百年，临床效果显著，但其抗RA的机制尚未完全阐明。研究目的：探讨八角枫对抗RA的作用及其潜在机制。材料与方法：通过CII/IFA诱导RA大鼠模型，口服给予或不给予八角枫乙酸乙酯提取物（ACEE）及雷公藤多苷（GTW）。随后评估关节炎评分、血清炎症因子及组织学评价，以判断关节疾病程度。采用LC-MS/MS进行蛋白质组学分析，初步阐明ACEE的机制，并通过免疫组织化学、免疫荧光、蛋白质印迹和分子对接进一步验证。结果：ACEE减轻了RA大鼠的关节肿胀、细胞脱落及关节组织坏死性关节病变，并降低了TNF-α、IL-1β、IL-6、PGE2、TGF-β的表达。同时，观察到ACEE处理组中差异表达蛋白，这些蛋白涉及RA、剪接体、细胞粘附分子、吞噬体和溶酶体信号通路。此外，ACEE显著改善关节病变，抑制JAK-STAT通路（JAK3、p-JAK3、STAT3、iNOS、RANKL）、COX-2通路（COX-2、TNF-α、IL-6、IL-1β、5-LOX）及自噬信号通路（LC3-Ⅰ、LC3-Ⅱ、p62、mTOR），但对COX-1、JAK1、JAK2、TyK2的表达影响甚微。结论：首次证据表明，八角枫显著改善RA，其潜在免疫机制涉及通过靶向调控JAK3-STAT3和COX-2通路来减少自噬。
